output.review_comment: The implementation includes suspiciously specific logic (values in [1.0, 2.0) always round up) that appears reverse-engineered from test cases rather than derived from a documented spec. The PR description presents this as "the storage team's spec," but should instead reference the actual test cases to justify these rules. The logic is also duplicated and complex. Before merging, provide the actual test cases that validate this behavior and explain why the [1.0, 2.0) range specifically requires ceiling instead of standard rounding.
